text:
sophia_marketing: Heads up — EU embedding endpoints are experiencing increased latency since 06:10 UTC. Need marketing copy for status page + guidance for customer emails and webinar registrants. Who can help draft and approve?

mike_ops: I can draft voice. Is this only eu-west? ops-oncall confirmed oncall has a mitigation running.

sophia_marketing: yes eu-west primarily. Some spillover to eu-central. We should avoid scaring customers — tone: transparent, actionable, ETA-focused.

jordan_support: tagging support queue routing — incoming tickets about webinar ingest and embeddings. Recommend we auto-assign to EU support pod.

emma_csm: Also flag Dedicated customers — they get a separate notice from CSMs + account teams. Do not send the mass email to accounts with open escalations.

oliver_prod: quick note: we have a degraded KV-cache layer causing longer tail latencies. Mitigation applied, but can take ~30–60m to see improvements.

sophia_marketing: Draft status copy below, please review. Want to push to status in next 5–10m after approvals.

sophia_marketing: ```
Incident: Increased latency for embeddings in EU regions
Status: Investigating
Started: 2026-03-21 06:10 UTC
Impact: API requests for embeddings and related features may see higher latency or timeouts for affected customers in EU regions.
Scope: Primarily eu-west, partial impact in eu-central. Dedicated customers may be routed to alternate capacity.
Next steps: Engineers are actively rolling mitigations. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes and an ETA when available.
Advice for customers: Retry requests, enable client-side timeouts/retries. Contact support for urgent issues (include request IDs).
```

mike_ops: copy is good. Suggest swap "Investigating" -> "Mitigating" once ops confirms mitigation started. Also add link to status page updates.

sophia_marketing: good call. jordan_support — what's the recommended support reply snippet for tickets?

jordan_support: use this short snippet for auto-replies: "Thanks — we're aware of increased latency in EU embeddings. Engineers are mitigating. If you can share request IDs and region, we'll prioritize." Add escalation keyword `priority-incident`.

emma_csm: For webinar registrants: we should send a short note that the product is experiencing degraded performance and the live demo might be affected; offer to reschedule demos and offer recordings. Send only to registrants for the next 24h window.

sophia_marketing: Timing question — do we publish status first then email registrants, or email first?

mike_ops: publish status first (so it's canonical), then email registrants linking to status page. If mitigation succeeds quickly, we can retract/update.

nora_pm: For inbound lead routing: new leads from webinar landing pages within impacted regions should be tagged `eu-impact` and routed to on-duty SDR + CSM if they are trialing embeddings. We should pause automated churn scoring until metrics stabilize.

sophia_marketing: Good. jordan_support — can you set the auto-assign for EU pod and add `eu-impact` tag on leads?

jordan_support: Yep, will set rule. ETA 10m.

sophia_marketing: Final checklist before I publish: 1) Ops confirm mitigation state, 2) Support auto-reply in place, 3) Status page uploaded, 4) Registrant email ready, 5) Lead routing tag set. Mark when done.

mike_ops: mitigation is applied now, moving status from Investigating -> Mitigating.

jordan_support: support auto-reply and routing set.

emma_csm: registrant email copy ready, hold until status published.

sophia_marketing: publishing status now. will post registrant email at +5m.

sophia_marketing: :loudspeaker: Published.

deploy-bot: statuspage update posted by sophia_marketing at 2026-03-21T06:25:10Z

sophia_marketing: emailing registrants in 2m. short note, link to status, reschedule CTA.

oliver_prod: monitoring latency curve; numbers improving but still above baseline. keep channel updated.

sophia_marketing: thanks everyone — will send follow-up update after the next mitigation check. :thumbsup:
